reference.array_contract: numpy.ndarray with image shape (H, W) or (H, W, C); image pixels use uint8 unless an operation explicitly says otherwise

dispatch_contract.pr0_runtime_switch: not implemented; this fixture defines the PR1 contract only

parity_tiers.E: bit-exact output or exact semantic result
parity_tiers.T: numeric tolerance recorded per operation and enforced against the OpenCV reference
parity_tiers.D: documented semantic or visual divergence with operation-specific invariants and golden coverage

operations.name: convert_color
operations.input_contract: contiguous uint8 grayscale, BGR, BGRA, RGB, or HSV image
operations.output_contract: new contiguous uint8 image with the code-selected channel shape
operations.error_contract: ValueError for unsupported channel shape or conversion code

operations.name: split_channels
operations.input_contract: uint8 image with 1, 3, or 4 channels
operations.output_contract: one contiguous two-dimensional uint8 array per channel, preserving order
operations.error_contract: ValueError for unsupported image shape

operations.name: merge_channels
operations.input_contract: non-empty equal-shaped two-dimensional uint8 channels
operations.output_contract: contiguous HWC uint8 image with input channel order
operations.error_contract: ValueError for empty or differently shaped channels

operations.name: flip
operations.input_contract: uint8 image and flip code -1, 0, or 1
operations.output_contract: contiguous copy with unchanged shape and dtype
operations.error_contract: ValueError for unsupported flip code

operations.name: copy_make_border
operations.signature: copy_make_border(image, top, bottom, left, right, value) -> ndarray
operations.input_contract: uint8 grayscale, BGR, or BGRA image and non-negative integer borders
operations.output_contract: new image with requested dimensions; constant padding preserves BGR/BGRA order and sets BGRA padding alpha to zero
operations.error_contract: ValueError for negative borders or unsupported channel shape

operations.name: add_weighted
operations.signature: add_weighted(src1, alpha, src2, beta, gamma) -> ndarray
operations.input_contract: equal-shaped uint8 images with matching channel shape
operations.output_contract: new uint8 image with saturating arithmetic and OpenCV-compatible tie rounding
operations.error_contract: ValueError for shape or channel mismatch

operations.name: convert_scale_abs
operations.input_contract: numeric image and finite scale/offset values
operations.output_contract: uint8 absolute, scaled, saturated image
operations.error_contract: ValueError for non-finite scale or offset

operations.name: mean
operations.input_contract: numeric grayscale or multi-channel image; optional uint8 mask with matching H/W
operations.output_contract: four-value tuple padded with zeros, matching OpenCV channel order
operations.error_contract: ValueError for mask shape mismatch

operations.name: resize
operations.input_contract: non-empty numeric image and positive (width, height); nearest and linear interpolation are required
operations.output_contract: new contiguous image with requested dimensions and compatible dtype
operations.error_contract: ValueError for non-positive dimensions or unsupported interpolation

operations.name: read_image
operations.input_contract: filesystem path and unchanged, grayscale, or color read flag
operations.output_contract: BGR/BGRA/grayscale ndarray; unchanged preserves supported alpha and bit depth
operations.error_contract: return None for missing, unreadable, or unsupported input; do not raise for a normal decode miss

operations.name: write_image
operations.input_contract: filesystem path and uint8 grayscale, BGR, or BGRA image
operations.output_contract: boolean success result; written files preserve BGR/BGRA semantics on read-back
operations.error_contract: return False for unsupported extension or write failure

operations.name: rotation_matrix
operations.input_contract: finite center, angle, and scale values
operations.output_contract: float64 matrix with shape (2, 3), mapping source coordinates like OpenCV
operations.error_contract: ValueError for non-finite values or zero scale

operations.name: warp_affine
operations.input_contract: numeric image, finite 2x3 matrix, positive output size, and supported interpolation
operations.output_contract: new image with requested dimensions and source dtype
operations.error_contract: ValueError for invalid matrix, size, or interpolation

operations.name: blur
operations.input_contract: numeric image and positive odd or even kernel dimensions
operations.output_contract: same shape and dtype with BORDER_REFLECT_101-equivalent edge handling
operations.error_contract: ValueError for non-positive kernel dimensions

operations.name: distance_transform
operations.input_contract: uint8 binary mask and supported L2 mask size
operations.output_contract: float32 distance image with zero at background
operations.error_contract: ValueError for non-binary mask or unsupported distance configuration

parity.notes: fallback exact EDT is intentionally not bit-identical to OpenCV chamfer-3; threshold semantics require operation-specific tests

operations.name: contour_area
operations.input_contract: finite contour vertices shaped (N, 2) or (N, 1, 2)
operations.output_contract: shoelace area with OpenCV orientation convention
operations.error_contract: ValueError for fewer than three vertices or non-finite coordinates

operations.name: approximate_polygon
operations.input_contract: finite 2D curve with at least one vertex and non-negative epsilon
operations.output_contract: ordered curve with OpenCV-compatible shape and dtype
operations.error_contract: ValueError for invalid curve or negative epsilon

operations.name: intersect_convex_polygons
operations.input_contract: finite convex polygons with at least three vertices
operations.output_contract: intersection area and ordered float64 polygon; no float32 overshoot
operations.error_contract: ValueError for non-convex or invalid polygons

operations.name: connected_components
operations.input_contract: uint8 binary mask and connectivity 4 or 8
operations.output_contract: deterministically numbered labels with background label zero
operations.error_contract: ValueError for invalid connectivity or mask shape

operations.name: connected_components_with_stats
operations.signature: connected_components_with_stats(mask, connectivity=8) -> tuple[int, ndarray, ndarray, ndarray]
operations.input_contract: uint8 binary mask and connectivity 4 or 8
operations.output_contract: labels, integer stats, and float centroids with background row
operations.error_contract: ValueError for invalid connectivity or mask shape

operations.name: find_contours
operations.signature: find_contours(mask, mode, method) -> tuple[list[ndarray], ndarray | None]
operations.input_contract: uint8 binary mask, RETR_TREE/RETR_CCOMP mode, and CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE or NONE method
operations.output_contract: ordered contours with OpenCV-compatible vertex shape; hierarchy may be discarded by callers
operations.error_contract: ValueError for non-binary mask, unsupported mode, or unsupported method

parity.notes: ordering, orientation, SIMPLE compression, and pathological masks remain explicit follow-up gates

operations.name: draw_line
operations.signature: draw_line(scene, start, end, color, thickness, line_type=8) -> None
operations.input_contract: mutable uint8 BGR/BGRA scene and integer coordinates/color
operations.output_contract: mutates scene in place; no return value
operations.error_contract: ValueError for invalid scene shape or thickness

parity.notes: anti-aliased edge pixels are allowed to differ and require golden-image budgets

operations.name: draw_rectangle
operations.signature: draw_rectangle(scene, start, end, color, thickness, line_type=8) -> None
operations.input_contract: mutable uint8 BGR/BGRA scene and integer coordinates/color
operations.output_contract: mutates scene in place; negative thickness means filled rectangle
operations.error_contract: ValueError for invalid scene shape or thickness

operations.name: draw_circle
operations.signature: draw_circle(scene, center, radius, color, thickness, line_type=8) -> None
operations.input_contract: mutable uint8 BGR/BGRA scene and integer center/radius/color
operations.output_contract: mutates scene in place; negative thickness means filled circle
operations.error_contract: ValueError for negative radius or invalid scene shape

operations.name: draw_ellipse
operations.signature: draw_ellipse(scene, center, axes, angle, start_angle, end_angle, color, thickness) -> None
operations.input_contract: mutable uint8 BGR/BGRA scene and finite ellipse geometry
operations.output_contract: mutates scene in place
operations.error_contract: ValueError for invalid axes, angles, or scene shape

operations.name: draw_polylines
operations.signature: draw_polylines(scene, points, closed, color, thickness, line_type=8) -> None
operations.input_contract: mutable uint8 BGR/BGRA scene and finite integer point arrays
operations.output_contract: mutates scene in place
operations.error_contract: ValueError for malformed point arrays or invalid scene shape

operations.name: fill_polygon
operations.input_contract: mutable uint8 BGR/BGRA scene and one or more finite integer polygons
operations.output_contract: mutates scene in place; filled region follows even-odd polygon semantics
operations.error_contract: ValueError for malformed polygons or invalid scene shape

operations.name: draw_contours
operations.signature: draw_contours(scene, contours, contour_index, color, thickness) -> None
operations.input_contract: mutable uint8 BGR/BGRA scene and OpenCV-shaped contours
operations.output_contract: mutates scene in place
operations.error_contract: ValueError for invalid contour index or scene shape

operations.name: get_text_size
operations.signature: get_text_size(text, font_face, font_scale, thickness) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], int]
operations.input_contract: string, accepted Hershey font face including italic modifier, finite non-negative scale, and non-negative thickness
operations.output_contract: integer (width, height) and integer baseline with OpenCV Hershey metrics
operations.error_contract: ValueError for unsupported font face, negative scale, or negative thickness

parity.case: all accepted faces, empty and multi-character strings

operations.name: draw_text
operations.signature: draw_text(scene, text, origin, font_face, font_scale, color, thickness, line_type=8) -> None
operations.input_contract: mutable uint8 BGR/BGRA scene, supported text, accepted Hershey face, finite scale, and non-negative thickness
operations.output_contract: mutates scene in place using the same baseline convention as get_text_size
operations.error_contract: ValueError for unsupported font face or invalid scene/text parameters

parity.notes: font asset provenance and per-face rendering budgets remain PR5 gates

operations.name: open_video_reader
operations.input_contract: path-based file video; device indices are outside the Supervision fallback contract
operations.output_contract: is_opened, read, grab, get, set, release; frames are contiguous uint8 BGR arrays
operations.error_contract: MediaError for missing, invalid, or truncated files; release is idempotent

parity.case: CFR/VFR metadata, exact start seek, lifecycle

operations.name: open_video_writer
operations.input_contract: path, positive fps, (width, height), contiguous uint8 BGR frames, and FourCC string
operations.output_contract: is_opened, write, release; release is idempotent and default mp4v is guaranteed
operations.error_contract: MediaError for unavailable encoder, invalid frame shape, or write failure

parity.notes: availability is platform/wheel dependent and must be capability-probed

image_formats.alpha: preserve when supported by the codec

hershey_fonts.source_candidate: OpenCV modules/imgproc/src/hershey_fonts.cpp and drawing.cpp font tables
hershey_fonts.license_status: maintainer attribution wording required before asset reuse
hershey_fonts.parity_status: metric and rendering parity not yet proven

hershey.source: OpenCV hershey_fonts.cpp plus drawing.cpp font tables
